data.name: Rolph
data.gender_notes: Rolph is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old High German name Hrodulf, which means 'fame wolf' or 'renowned wolf'. This name was commonly given to warriors and rulers. The name Rolph carries the meaning “Wolf Counselor” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Rolph usually hope their child will grow to embody wolf counselor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents courage, leadership, and strength. It is a reminder to face challenges with bravery and to protect those who are important to us.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rolph total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

Today, people with the name Rolph may be seen as strong-willed, confident, and assertive, and may feel a deep connection to their heritage and past.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Rolph may also carry spiritual significance as a reminder of God's protection and strength. The name Hrodulf suggested a warrior who was renowned, noted for his valor and victory. In a spiritual sense, the name Rolph could serve as a reminder to always put one's faith and trust in God, to rely on His strength and guidance in all situations, and to strive to be a light and a warrior for the Lord in the world. Ultimately, the name Rolph can be seen as a call to live a life of bravery and courage, filled with the strength of God.
